column1: # Book 5 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 5.1239-1240 viris is accusative in apposition to potestatis: mortals leave great powers, the strengths of the gods, in the world; not a dative recipient.

column2: and leave in the world great and marvelous powers,
the strengths of the gods, to steer all things?
